h1: The 6 Best Murphy Beds for Home Offices of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Home Office Murphy Beds: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six Murphy beds and kits for home offices, sorted by size, storage, build effort, finish and desk friendliness.
summary: The Create-A-Bed Queen kit is the best choice for a true home office, because you build the cabinet and desk to your own measurements. The AMERLIFE Queen is the ready made pick with side storage and charging, and the Yoobure rattan model is the one that looks finished in a shared room. The LIVAUVEAD twin is the answer when floor width is your tightest limit.
intro: The biggest surprise in this category is that almost no Murphy bed in a box includes a desk. You get a bed that folds into a cabinet, and the office part is up to you, which means the real question is how much of the build you want to take on yourself.

We went through six Murphy beds and kits from the page, drawing on spec sheets and what owners report about assembly and daily use. We ranked them on build flexibility, storage, size, finish and how well they leave room for a working desk. Two near duplicate Hlivelood variants were left out so each pick offers something different.

products.name: Create-A-Bed Queen Size Deluxe Murphy Bed Kit, Vertical
products.verdict: Hardware you build into your own cabinet, so the desk can fit your exact room.
products.description:
The Create-A-Bed Deluxe kit is a queen size vertical wall bed mechanism with gas piston lift assist. It is sold as hardware only, so you build the cabinet yourself, and a step by step installation guide is included.

It ranks first because building the cabinet means you can add a deep desk, monitor arms and shelves sized to your room, which no ready made unit offers. The cost is time and tools, and it sits in the $200 to $500 range before lumber.

Buy it if you are comfortable with carpentry and want an office that fits your exact space. If you want to open a box and be done, choose a ready made cabinet.
products.idealFor: DIY builders wanting a custom office.
products.skipIf: You want a ready made cabinet.

products.name: AMERLIFE Queen Murphy Bed with Storage and Charging Station
products.verdict: A finished cabinet bed with side storage and a built in charging station.
products.description:
The AMERLIFE is a queen size cabinet Murphy bed with side storage compartments, a built in charging station and MDF cabinet construction. It has a foldable platform base.

It ranks second because it needs no cabinet building, which makes it the quickest way to a guest bed in an office. The charging station and side storage are handy, but you will need a separate desk because the cabinet itself does not provide one.

Choose it if you want built in storage and a guest bed without a DIY build. It sits in the $200 to $500 range.
products.idealFor: Guest bed with storage, no DIY.
products.skipIf: You want a built in desk.

products.name: Yoobure Queen Murphy Bed with Charging Station, Rattan Frame with Storage Drawers
products.verdict: A rattan front cabinet that still looks like furniture when the bed is up.
products.description:
The Yoobure is a queen cabinet bed with a rattan front, a charging station, storage drawers and a foldable platform base.

It ranks third because it matches the AMERLIFE on function while leaning on style. The rattan front looks more like decor than a bed cabinet, which helps in a shared living space or studio.

Choose it for a studio or living room where the office is part of a room that guests also see. It sits in the $200 to $500 range.
products.skipIf: You want a built in desk.

products.name: Queen Size Murphy Bed Hardware Kit, Vertical Wall Bed Frame with Gas Pistons
products.verdict: A cheaper DIY kit with three build guides and gas pistons.
products.description:
This kit is a queen size vertical wall bed mechanism with gas pistons, three step by step build guides and North American manufacturing. It is hardware only.

It ranks fourth because it offers the same DIY flexibility as the Create-A-Bed at a lower price, in the $100 to $200 range, but with less information on the lift hardware. The multiple build guides help beginners.

Choose it if you want to build a custom desk and bed combo and want to save on the mechanism.
products.skipIf: You do not own basic tools.

products.name: Hlivelood Queen Size Murphy Bed with 2 LED Lights, Gas Struts, Rustic White
products.verdict: A queen cabinet bed with two built in LED lights.
products.description:
The Hlivelood queen bed has two built in LED lights, gas strut fold assist, a rustic white cabinet finish and needs no box spring.

It ranks fifth because the lights are the main extra and it sits in the $500 and up bracket, higher than the ready made options above. The lights replace a separate lamp, and the white finish reflects light.

Buy it if you want lighting in the cabinet itself and have the budget. It does not include a desk.

products.name: LIVAUVEAD Twin Size Murphy Bed with Charging Station and Drawer, White
products.verdict: A twin size cabinet bed for rooms where width is the limit.
products.description:
The LIVAUVEAD is a twin size cabinet Murphy bed with a built in charging station, a single storage drawer, a white finish and a foldable platform base.

It ranks last because a twin bed is too small for many guests, though it takes the least floor width of the group. The drawer and charging port add some convenience.

Choose it for a small, single occupant home office where room width is the tightest constraint. It sits in the $200 to $500 range.

whatMatters.detail: Very few Murphy beds include a desk, so the question is whether the bed lets you add one. Hardware kits let you build a desk into the cabinet, while ready made units need a separate desk placed nearby. Read the listing for the word desk and decide if you can live without one.

A kit gives you only the lift mechanism and you build the cabinet. A ready made cabinet arrives with panels and hardware to assemble. Kits cost less for the hardware but more in time, and require tools.
Twin saves floor width, while queen fits couples but takes a wider wall. Measure the wall and the floor depth when open. Compare the listing's dimensions with your room.
Gas pistons or struts carry most of the bed's weight so you can fold it with one hand. Weak mechanisms feel heavy or slam down. Look for gas piston or gas strut in the title.
MDF and particleboard are common in ready made cabinets, while a DIY build can use solid wood. Material affects weight, sturdiness and look. Check the listing for the cabinet material.

faq.q: Do Murphy beds include a desk?
faq.a: Almost none do. Kits let you build one into the cabinet, and ready made units need a separate desk.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake when buying one?
faq.a: Ignoring ceiling and floor clearance. Measure the open bed's depth and the wall width before you order.

faq.q: Is a DIY kit worth it over a ready made bed?
faq.a: If you want a built in desk and own tools, yes. If you want speed, the cabinet is easier.
Ready made cabinets need several hours and often two people. Kits need cabinet carpentry and wall anchoring.

faq.q: Does the bed need to be anchored?
faq.a: Wall bed mechanisms should be secured to studs following the maker's guide, especially for kits.
Yes, in most cases. Check the listing for mattress size and thickness limits.

finalTake: For a real home office, the Create-A-Bed Queen kit is the best Murphy bed because you can fit a desk to your own room. The AMERLIFE is the ready made choice with storage, and the Yoobure suits shared spaces. Pick the LIVAUVEAD twin if floor width is your limit.
